title: Studio flow item header at 1024 px: the Read-only chip folds before it is cut to "Rea"
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `efa9cb4fa` at 1024 px, Studio › HotCRM › Automations › Enroll Members in Campaign: the item header's tab row reads "Canvas · Variables · Runs · Problems 1 · Debug · [Rea" — the Read-only chip at the row's end is clipped to three letters. objectui#12611 kept the title and the tab labels readable at this width; the chip in the tab row was not in its scope.

## Target

1. The chip in a tab row folds to its icon with a tooltip when the row cannot hold it, and is never clipped mid-word; the tab labels keep `nowrap` and the row scrolls horizontally as objectui#12611 set.
2. The same rule for the item headers of the Data and Interfaces pillars (the Unpublished draft chip).

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` (the pillar item header and its chips), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: the chip renders its icon-only form at a 560 px tab row; full form at 800 px.
2. Screenshot of the flow item header at 1024 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `0f4e3f4ee`, never merged): [r4-studio-automations-rail.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-studio-automations-rail.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 fourth review: objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, HotCRM `4f82b815` on platform 18.0.0-next.2, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (dark, en). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed on the repository it belongs to, verbatim: 「全部立卡，平台问题到 objectui，审计日志核查到 objectstack，HotCRM 转化流程到 hotcrm。」</sub>
